modmenu.descriptionTranslation.starforge: Endgame star-metal arsenal and twelve new enchantments.
enchantment.starforge.starfall.desc: Each hit drives a sliver of falling star into the target.
enchantment.starforge.cinderbrand.desc: Sets the target alight and saps its strength.
enchantment.starforge.soulrend.desc: Withers what you cut, and mends what cut it.
enchantment.starforge.stormcaller.desc: A chance to call lightning down on whatever you strike.
enchantment.starforge.skybreaker.desc: Turns every block you fall into extra mace damage.
enchantment.starforge.aegis.desc: A broad, heavy ward against all incoming harm.
enchantment.starforge.titanheart.desc: More health, more toughness, and a body that will not be moved.
enchantment.starforge.voidstep.desc: Faster feet, longer falls, taller steps.
enchantment.starforge.gravitas.desc: Gravity loosens its grip on you.
enchantment.starforge.starlight.desc: Luck, breath, and clear sight underwater.
enchantment.starforge.quarrymind.desc: Tears through stone and squeezes more experience from it.
enchantment.starforge.eternal.desc: Your gear wears out far more slowly and drinks experience to heal.

advancements.starforge.root.title: Starforge
advancements.starforge.root.description: The sky owes you metal. Come and collect.
advancements.starforge.voidshard.title: Splinter of Nowhere
advancements.starforge.voidshard.descrip: Cut a shard out of the space between places.
advancements.starforge.starsteel.title: Star-Metal
advancements.starforge.starsteel.descrip: Quench netherite in void water and see what survives.
advancements.starforge.astral_core.title: The Heart of It
advancements.starforge.astral_core.descr: Fold a dead star down into something you can hold.
advancements.starforge.starfall_blade.de: Forge the blade that falls with it.
advancements.starforge.worldbreaker.desc: Forge a mace that argues with gravity.
advancements.starforge.voidpiercer.title: Loose the Dark
advancements.starforge.voidpiercer.descr: String a bow with a piece of the void.
advancements.starforge.starforge_pickaxe: Forge the pick that remembers stone as dust.
advancements.starforge.full_plate.title: Wrapped in Starlight
advancements.starforge.full_plate.descri: Carry the whole Starforge plate at once.
advancements.starforge.heart_of_the_star: Death made a suggestion. Refuse it.
advancements.starforge.ascendant.title: Ascendant
advancements.starforge.ascendant.descrip: Hold the complete Starforge arsenal in one inventory.
